🚀 effectcraft | Rust
🎯 Primary Use Case: Creating motion graphics, visual effects, and animated titles.
✨ Key Features: • Motion graphics and compositing tool • Rust implementation • After Effects-like interface and behavior • Lottie import and export • Readable JSON project files
📖 Summary: EffectCraft is an open-source motion graphics and compositing tool written in Rust, aiming to be a clean-room reimplementation of Adobe After Effects. It offers features like Lottie import/export, scriptability, and a readable project file format, making it suitable for creating animated titles, motion graphics, and visual effects.
